  A kitchen-sink page that uses every element the openair theme styles, so
  changes to the template can be checked in one place.
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

This page exists to preview the **openairpkgdown** theme. It isn't documentation: it puts every element the theme styles on one page. To preview a package's colour, change `primary` in this repo's `_pkgdown.yml` and rebuild with `pkgdown::build_site()`.

The lead paragraph above should be slightly larger and softer than body text. Here is an [inline link](https://openair-project.github.io/openair/), some `inline code`, and a linked function name: [`summary()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/summary.html).

## Code

A chunk with source and output:

```{r}
x <- c(12.1, 18.4, 22.9, 31.0, 27.5, 15.2)
summary(x)
```

A longer chunk, to check scrolling and syntax highlighting:

```{r}
daily_mean <- function(data, pollutant = "no2", na.rm = TRUE) {
  # group by date and take the mean of a pollutant
  dates <- as.Date(data$date)
  tapply(data[[pollutant]], dates, mean, na.rm = na.rm)
}

dat <- data.frame(
  date = rep(seq(as.POSIXct("2024-01-01"), by = "6 hours", length.out = 8)),
  no2 = c(41, 38, 52, 47, 35, 33, 44, 50)
)
daily_mean(dat)
```

Messages, warnings and errors:

```{r, error = TRUE}
message("Downloading data from the AURN...")
warning("3 sites returned no data.")
stop("`pollutant` must be a character vector.")
```

## Plots

```{r, fig.alt = "A line chart of hourly NO2 concentrations over two days."}
set.seed(1)
no2 <- 30 + 15 * sin(seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 48)) + rnorm(48, sd = 4)
plot(no2, type = "l", lwd = 2, xlab = "Hour", ylab = "NO2 (ug/m3)")
```
